Number of half-lives \(= \frac{28}{7} = 4\)

Fraction remaining \(= \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{4} = \frac{1}{16}\)

text: Which of the following statements about radioactivity are correct? I. Beta particles are fast-moving electrons carrying a negative charge II. Radioactive decay is a spontaneous and random process III. Gamma rays carry a positive charge

The answer is I and II only.

text: A radioactive substance has a half-life of 26 days. If 512g of the substance is kept for 130 days, what mass remains undecayed?
